title: 'Can't run law classes here': Delhi High Court refuses to entertain PIL over Jhandewalan temple restrictions
description: The Delhi High Court on Wednesday refused to entertain a public interest litigation (PIL) petition challenging alleged restrictions imposed by the Jhandewalan temple management on the devotees' access to the temple's deity.A Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia held that the petition was not maintainable under its writ jurisdiction.
